headline: Cape Ledger Turns as Fronts Stir
war_summary: Since the last edition, Callum’s Cape is listed at four Colonial bases to three Warden, with no neutral sites; its 48 recorded events in 24 hours mark the heaviest turnover, chiefly at Naofa, Scouts Jest and Ire. Lykos Isle remains wholly Colonial-held after its earlier change, while Marban Hollow’s divided count—three bases apiece and two neutral—holds steady. The principal unsettled ledgers elsewhere remain Linn Mercy (nine Colonial, one Warden, one neutral) and Weathered Expanse (two Colonial, five Warden, two neutral); each registered six or more events in the last two hours, alongside substantial casualty increments. Mooring County retains a nine-to-three Warden lead, with eight events in six hours but none in the latest two. Thus the busiest lines show varying tempo: the Cape continues to turn, Linn and Weathered are active now, and Mooring’s recent rush has paused. The war remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
